feeds.title: Grandparents Link
feeds.description: Grandparentslink gives immediate access to all that is grand for grandparents, parents, children, and families. We talk about new trends and resources that are of interest in our life; answer questions about how and what to do; discuss relationships and feature topics on health, nutrition, and well-being; offer product reviews and even share our tried and true recipes.

feeds.title: Nanahood
feeds.description: Nanahood is a grandparent blog authored by Teresa Bell Kindred.

feeds.title: Grandma Ideas

feeds.title: Good To Great Grandparenting Blog
feeds.description: Good To Great Grandparenting by Neil Taft offers Tips and Activities for Grandparents and Grandkids and discusses the benefits of Grandparenting. Neil is a professional Public Speaker, tireless Youth Advocate, and published author of two books on Grandparenting and nearly 400 articles on two websites.

feeds.title: The Grandmother Gig
feeds.description: I'm a wife, a mom, a home economist (I worked for our university co-operative extension service for 10 years,) a musician (I taught guitar for 10 years,) a knitter, and now--a grandmother! All of the other jobs just helped get me ready for this most important one. Becoming a grandmother is wonderful. One moment you're just a mother. The next you are all-wise and prehistoric.

feeds.title: The Geogram Weekly
feeds.description: Hi Grandma G here! At 71 I have been living in Vancouver, WA for 4 and a half years. I invite you to follow my adventures as I continue to develop my life as a single, 'mountain mama' grandma.

feeds.title: Crafty Nana's Blog
feeds.description: I have always loved doing crafts and for the past 15 years I have been scrapbooking and making cards for family and friends. I love to share my crafts and hope you enjoy looking.

feeds.title: This is Your Best Year
feeds.description: Life changes as we mature, but that's not a bad thing. We're here to write about things that pertain to women who are a certain age, who will one day be a woman of a certain age, or know a woman of a certain age - we are for everyone. Sometimes our conversation will be funny, sometimes it will make you think. It will always be informative. You are invited to come along with us on this journey because we know 'thisisyourbestyear'.

feeds.title: Grandma's cookie jar
